m: Roast the cherry tomatoes at 200°C with oil and salt for 15 minutes.
Make the stock: stock powder dissolved in 350ml hot water per serve. Keep it warm.
Fry the sliced chorizo until crisp, remove. Soften the onion in the chorizo oil 3 minutes, add half the garlic, then the rice. Toast 1 minute.
Add stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18 to 20 minutes until creamy.
Meanwhile sizzle the prawns with the rest of the garlic, 2 minutes a side. Add them and the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in butter, parmesan and lemon. Top with chorizo, tomatoes and parsley.
l: Reheat with a splash of water and stir well. Prawns are best eaten within a day.
g: Naturally gluten free. Check the stock powder and chorizo.
